raw_blocks: DHI Group, Inc. (NYSE: DHX) is a family of purpose-built talent platforms - each built for a specific professional community, not a one-size-fits-all marketplace. DHI Group powers ClearanceJobs and Dice, the platforms top tech talent turn to and employers rely on. Together, they connect nearly 10 million tech professionals; engineers, software developers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts, AI specialists, and more, with the employers who need them. Our AI-powered tools and proprietary skills algorithm do the heavy lifting, matching the right candidate to the right opening, fast.

Dice is the largest technology-focused talent marketplace in the United States, built over more than 35 years with nearly 8 million technology profiles. Unlike generalized professional networking platforms, Dice organizes talent around more than 100,000 distinct technology skills, allowing recruiters to identify candidates based on the precise capabilities they need.

ClearanceJobs is the leading marketplace for professionals with active U.S. security clearances, serving approximately 1,700 customers, including Lockheed Martin, Booz Allen Hamilton, Leidos, Raytheon, and many others. ClearanceJobs has 2 million cleared candidate profiles, reinforcing our position as the industry's premier destination for cleared technology talent.
The leading tech career network connecting tech professionals with top employers.
The largest career network for professionals with security clearances.

pages.raw_title: DHI Group, Inc. - About - Company Profile
raw_blocks: At DHI Group, Inc. (NYSE: DHX), we operate a family of purpose-built talent platforms, each built for a distinct professional community, not a one-size-fits-all marketplace. Dice is the leading career marketplace for technologists, connecting employers with the talent powering digital transformation. ClearanceJobs is the largest security-cleared career network, serving the defense, intelligence, and government contracting community under its "Expand the Mission" strategy, extended through targeted acquisitions including AgileATS and Point Solutions Group (PSG).

Each platform keeps the focus and identity that earned it category leadership. What we provide underneath is shared scale, capital discipline, an M&A engine, and centralized corporate functions, so each platform can invest fully in the customers it knows best.

We believe DHI is uniquely positioned at the intersection of two powerful, durable trends: rising global defense spending and growing demand for highly specialized technology talent, particularly in AI.
We are successfully extending our platforms into adjacent services, creating new monetization opportunities and deepening our relationships with customers.
Importantly, our highly recurring revenue model and strong free cash flow give us the flexibility to invest
Our long term goal to deliver free cash flow at or above 10% of revenue.
